title: The Sweet Letters
author: Elodie Underhill
blurb: Silas Okonkwo, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
